title: FFmpeg Hardware Pipeline Planner
problem: Nako's transcode runtime still treats hardware acceleration as an encoder-only selected accelerator instead of a stage-aware decode/filter/encode pipeline.

evidence.summary: Opened the FFmpeg hardware pipeline planner lane and accepted ADR 0045 for stage-aware transcode pipeline ownership.
Added stage-aware hardware capability facts for decode, filter, encode, hwaccel, and bitstream-filter stages.
Added TranscodePipelinePlanner and removed the old selected-accelerator helper chain from production code.
Moved HLS FFmpeg command planning to pipeline-derived execution policies.
Updated Admin playback diagnostics to expose redaction-safe pipeline readiness and stage capability evidence.
Verified focused gates and closed the workstream with follow-ons documented in HANDOFF.md.

continue_policy.notes: This lane is closed. Open a follow-on for FFmpeg decoder/filter probe deepening, HDR tone mapping, subtitle burn-in, adaptive HLS ladders, or Admin Web diagnostics wiring.
